subject: MAP kickoff: Redwood x Finovo - draft & timeline options
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: James Carter <james.carter@finovo.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP kickoff: Redwood x Finovo - draft & timeline options

Hi James —

Thanks again for a productive discovery this morning. Per our conversation, I pulled together an initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP) draft that captures the milestones, owners, dependencies, and a couple of timeline options to consider. Attached: MAP-draft-v1.xlsx.

Quick recap from the call:
- Primary use cases: inference latency improvements on nightly batch scoring, and lower per-token cost for the customer-facing recommendation API.
- Primary success metrics: 99th percentile latency <= 120ms for API path, 30% cost reduction on batch workloads.
- Key constraints/dependencies: security questionnaire (SOC2), procurement timeline for reserved capacity, and Prod VPC peering schedule.

What I included in the MAP:
- Milestones (Discovery -> Pilot -> Technical Kickoff -> Contract & Procurement -> Go-live)
- Responsibilities (Redwood vs Finovo) mapped per milestone
- Target close date suggestions and two timeline options (aggressive / conservative)
- Open dependencies (security evidence, legal review, procurement PO)

Ask: can you confirm the Finovo stakeholders we should include on the MAP (security, procurement, IT), and which target close date you prefer? I included a placeholder target close of 2026-07-30 (aggressive) and 2026-08-15 (conservative).

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm stakeholders and preferred target close date.
2) We pick a 30-minute MAP kickoff next week to assign owners and lock dependencies (suggested times in the doc).
3) Redwood will update the MAP and circulate a final version for signatures.

Attachments: MAP-draft-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet with milestones & owners)

Thanks — looking forward to next steps.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0132

---
From: James Carter <james.carter@finovo.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@finovo.com>
Date: Fri, 26 Jun 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: Redwood x Finovo - draft & timeline options

Marissa —

Appreciate the clear recap and the MAP. I skimmed the spreadsheet this morning — overall this looks like the right structure. A few notes from our side:

- Stakeholders: please include me (James Carter, Dir. of Data Platforms), Samantha Lee (Security & Compliance), and Alex Nguyen (Head of SRE) on the MAP. I will loop procurement once we lock the target not-to-exceed pricing.
- Target close: 2026-07-30 (aggressive) could work but that's tight given legal and procurement. Can we plan for 2026-07-30 as our internal target and 2026-08-15 as the fall-back?
- Dependencies: Finovo will need the SOC2 evidence and the architecture diagram for VPC peering to complete our security review. Can Redwood share the SOC2 summary + redacted evidence and a sample VPC peering runbook?

Would like to schedule the MAP kickoff — I'm available next Tue (06/30) 10:00-11:00 AM PT or Wed (07/01) 1:00-2:00 PM PT. Can you propose a 30-minute slot and add an agenda?

Also attaching our procurement template so your legal team can see standard PO terms.

Thanks,
James
James Carter
Director, Data Platforms | Finovo
james.carter@finovo.com | (617) 555-0199

Attachments: Finovo-procurement-template.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: Redwood x Finovo - draft & timeline options

Thanks James — this is helpful. Replying with a quick update and next steps.

1) Stakeholders: I've added the three you listed to the MAP (you, Samantha, Alex). If there are others (procurement contact, infra ops lead) please reply-all with names/emails and we'll add them.

2) Requested artifacts: we'll deliver the following by EOD Tue (06/30):
   - SOC2 summary & evidence pack (redacted)
   - Architecture diagram + VPC peering runbook sample
   - Updated MAP (see attachment MAP-draft-v2.xlsx)

3) Timeline options (updated in MAP-draft-v2):
   - Option A (aggressive): Target close = 2026-07-30; milestones compressed, requires procurement sign-off by 07/14 and security review completed by 07/10.
   - Option B (conservative): Target close = 2026-08-15; milestones spread out, security/procurement buffer included.

4) Responsibilities (high level):
   - Redwood: deliver SOC2 evidence, provide sizing and pricing for Dedicated pool, schedule technical kickoff, provide integration guide and sample peering runbook.
   - Finovo: complete security review, confirm procurement terms/PO, provide VPC peering CIDR and contact for network config.

5) MAP kickoff meeting: Tue 06/30 10:00 AM PT works for us. I'll send a calendar invite for a 30-minute meeting with a short agenda: introductions, confirm stakeholders, pick timeline, assign owners, agree on deliverables and dates.

6) Open question: do you want the procurement contact included on the kickoff or looped after we confirm timeline? My suggestion is to include them so procurement can hear the timeline implications live.

Attachments: MAP-draft-v2.xlsx
